entities.summary: Friedrich Wilhelm Ferdinand Joseph Maria Manuel Georg Meinrad Fidelis Benedikt Michael Hubert Fürst von Hohenzollern was the head of the Swabian branch of the House of Hohenzollern for over 45 years.
